  | notes       = 
:* On first slotting
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Excellent.
:* On slotting
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: You've done well for me.
:* On feeding 
:: (Say): <<weapon>>:Soon I will be unstoppable!
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: We are unstoppable!
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Ahh. One step closer to attaining my full power.
:* On equipping
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: All who oppose us must die.
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Our time is coming. There will be a reckoning.
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Your foes face the wrath of the Black Abbot.
:* On unequipping
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: You have served me well.
:* On opening a chest
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: A glorious reward on the path towards my ascension!
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Let power swell forth from this treasure trove!
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: You've done well for me.
:* On gaining a filigree slot
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Ahh. One step closer to attaining my full power.
:* On removing the Sentient Jewel:
:* On quest completion / turn-in:
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Another step on our path to power is complete.
:* On picking up a quest
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Seize this opportunity. It is our destiny!
:* On being critically wounded / near death
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: You poor fool. You're at death's door!
:* On resurrection
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: You have returned? Good. You serve me once again!
:* Upon killing an enemy: 
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Bow before the Black Abbot!
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: I have destroyed you!
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Feel my wrath!
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Good work, my minion.
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Excellent.
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: We are unstoppable!
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Quake before us, foolish mortals!
:* When shrining:
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Rest quickly. We must attend to my ascension.
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Ah yes. I forget that mortal minions must rest.
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Refresh that fragile mortal body, and let's be on our way.
:* Being hit by a trap?:
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: That trap will pay for its insolence!
:* Disabling Traps:
:* When a party member dies
:* When someone dies
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Another poor fool gone.
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Your minion's death must not interfere with my ascension.
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Your minions dwindle.

:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Why must I be thwarted at every turn?
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: This is … disappointing.


:* When adding a filigree:
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: We are unstoppable!
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Ahhh.
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: You've done well for me.
:* On weapon damage:
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Be careful! I can't ascend if I'm in pieces.
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: I will chastise you if I'm damaged again. Severely.
:* On picking up collectibles:
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Collect your bauble and move on.
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Ahhh
:* On death:
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Shadow draws a veil across your short life.
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Get up! My plan for ascension must not be interrupted by something as mundane as your death.
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: I will destroy you all!
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Most foul!
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Curse them all!
:: (Say): <<weapon>>: Futile
